output.brief: The fall in first-contact resolution is mainly explained by a finance change, not by new agents or the IVR. On 14 April, Finance change FC-0417 cut the in-call credit limit from £100 to £25. Larger billing adjustments are now automatically referred to the Billing Resolution team. Billing referrals jumped from 7% to 54% that same week. Calls that were not referred stayed at 82% resolved, and referred calls stayed at about 34%, so the site-wide drop tracks the referral shift. The April intake looks no different from tenured agents, and the drop began before the IVR change. I am fairly confident in this, but the workload explanation was not tested, and the complaint link is only correlation. Next steps: do not put the April intake on performance plans. Agree a revised in-call credit limit with Finance, backed by post-call sampling, and trial it on two teams for six weeks while tracking FCR and unsupported credits. Hold off on restoring the limit for everyone. Keep the IVR phase-two work decision separate from this.
